decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved materials; Samples of Ibstock Brick in Ivanhoe Cream, Crest Brick in Pizarro, Glazed brick in Dark Grey, Aluminium/Wood windows and doors in RAL 7016, powder coated aluminium balcony panels in RAL7016, Marshalls Square Paving in Grey, Marshalls Priora in Brindle and Marshalls Priuora Paving in Buff as viewed on site on 18/06/2018 approved under reference 00676/33/S8(2-23a).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 3 - The use of the ground floor commercial/community premises shall only be for purpose or purposes falling within either Class A2 or Class D1, with the exception of the use of the premises as a religious meeting place, which shall be prohibited.
In respect of any of the above Class A2 or D1 uses hereby approved, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the first established use shall not be changed to any other Use Class without further approval in writing from the local planning authority

Condition : 4 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details approved on the 05/10/2017 under application 00676/33/S6(5,7,24,27).
During the course of the development:
(C). The Local Planning Authority (LPA) shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
(D). The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, the parking, loading and turning spaces as set out in the approved plans, shall be constructed and made available for use. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter. No loading or unloading shall occur on the public highway.

Condition : 6 - All construction work shall be undertaken in accordance with the construction management plan details (LT608-0-11 rev P3 and APPENDIX B - Site Delivery Routes prepared by Willmott Partnership Homes received on 01/08/2017, Sustainable Travel Management Plan prepared by Be Living received on 04/09/2017, Annotated plan ref. LT608-1-01 rev P4 received on 05/09/2017, Construction Management and Programme Methodology dated August 2017 prepared by Be Living received 06/09/2017) approved on the 05/10/2017 under application 00676/33/S6(5,7,24,27).

Condition : 7 - The cycle parking facilities for residents, employees and visitors shall be carried out in accordance with the details (NANT-ACA-Z0-00-DR-A-0002 rev P0, NANT-ACA-Z0-XX-DR-A-0205 rev P1, NANT-ACA-Z0-XX-DR-A-0206 rev P1 and FALCOLEVEL PREMIUM+ Two-tier Cycle Parking specification received on 09/04/2018) approved on the 02/07/2018 under application 00676/33/S8(2-23a).

Condition : 8 - No unit (residential or commercial) shall be occupied until a Car Park Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include the following:
"	details and location of one electric vehicle charging point and details of a further one passive provision;
"	details of parking layout and allocations (including details as to how the occupancy will be maximised through the lease of sales)
"	details of measures proposed to restrict parking to designated bays only and prohibit parking on the access road
The car parking areas shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.

Condition : 9 - No dwelling shall be occupied until arrangements have been agreed in writing with the local planning authority and put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Condition : 10 - Before first occupation of any unit of the development hereby approved, a Delivery and Servicing Plan (including details of vehicle access and egress arrangements and timing that servicing shall take place) shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall accord with current guidance such as that issued by TfL and include measures required to ensure sufficient arrangements - physical as well as managerial - for the servicing, including refuse collection, of all aspects of the development, the timing of hours for deliveries by motor vehicles and a timetable for implementation. The Plan shall be carried out as approved. The approved measures shall be implemented before the first occupation of the commercial unit hereby permitted and shall be so maintained for the life of the development.
Condition : 11 - No paraphernalia associated with the ground floor commercial / community unit hereby approved shall be stored outside of the building

Condition : 12 - Prior to first occupation of the building, details of the roof terraces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation and so maintained as such at all times thereafter.

Condition : 13 - The hard and soft landscaping for the site shall be carried out in accordance with the details (NANT-LP-Z0-00-DR-L-0100A , NANT-LP-Z0-00-DR-L-0200, NANT-LP-Z0-00-SH-L-0500A and Landscape Management Plan ref NANT-LP-Z0-00-RP-L-0501 dated February 2018 prepared by Landscape Perspective Limited received on 09/04/2018. NANT-ACA-Z0-00-DR-A-0001-C1 and NANT-ACA-Z1-XX-DR-A-0207 C1 received on 18/06/2018) approved on the 02/07/2018 under application 00676/33/S8(2-23a).
All landscaping comprised in the approved details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works. Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within three years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details approved and shall be maintained in accordance with the approved management programme at all times thereafter.

Condition : 14 - The windows between first and fourth floor formed in the north side elevation (adjacent to the boundary with Priory Court) shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 15 - Prior to the first occupation of the building, details of privacy screens to balconies and roof terraces shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The screens shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and thereafter maintained and retained as such.

Condition : 16 - Any fixed external plant shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10dB below the background noise levels when measured from the nearest sensitive receptors. All plant shall be installed in accordance with the approved plans. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 17 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 18 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details approved (Report ref. PJB8402/17128 dated 16th May 2018 prepared by Spectrum Acoustic Consultants received on 22/05/2018) on the 17/07/2018 under application 00676/33/S8(19a).
(B). Prior to the development being occupied, measurement reports demonstrating compliance with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 19 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details approved (Drainage Assessment Form completed by CTP Consulting Engineers dated 22/03/2018, NANT-CTP-Z1-00-DR-C-1505, NANT-CTP-Z1-00-SH-C-1501 and NANT-CTP-Z1-00-GA-C-1500 received on 10/05/2018. Drainage Report ref. A4445 dated 23 March 2018 received on 25/06/2018) on the 01/08/2018 under application 00676/33/S8(13,20).

Condition : 20 - Prior to occupation, the applicant must submit for review and approval by the Lead Local Flood Authority evidence that the drainage system has been built as per the final detailed drainage designs through the submission of photographs and copies of installation contracts, and written confirmation that the drainage features will be managed as per the detailed maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 21 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure and National Calculation Method should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 22 - (A) The development shall be completed in accordance with the details approved (Water Efficiency Calculations ref. NANT-THD-Z1-ZZ-CA-M-0003 rev 1 dated 7 March 2018 prepared by THD Consulting Engineers received on 09/04/2018) on the 02/07/2018 under application 00676/33/S8(2-23a).

(B) Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations.

Condition : 23 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Letter from Stroma Tech dated 9th June 2017, Sustainable Procurement Policy Statement prepared by Willmott Dixon, Sustainable Procurement Policy dated January 2015 prepared by Willmott Dixon Group and Group Risk Management ref. GP-PP-EM-305 Revision: A dated April 2016 prepared by Willmott Dixon Group received on 01/08/2017) approved on the 05/10/2017 under application 00676/33/S6(5,7,24,27). 
The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with these approved details.

Condition : 24 - A minimum of eight Wheelchair User Dwellings, built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard, shall be provided as shown on approved plans reference LT608-1-02 Rev P4, LT608-1-03 Rev P4, LT608-1-04 Rev P4, LT608-1-05 Rev P4, LT608-1-06 Rev P4, LT608-1-07 Rev P4 and LT608-1-08 Rev P4 received on 19/12/2016 and LT608-1-01 Rev P5 received on 16/12/2017.

Condition : 25 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details approved (NANT-CTP-00-B1-GA-C-1600 rev P4, NANT-CTP-00-B1-GA-C-1800 rev P2 and NANT-CTP-00-B1-GA-C-1605 rev P3 received on 27/09/2017) on the 05/10/2017 under application 00676/33/S6(5,7,24,27). The development shall not be occupied until the access road has been completed in accordance with these details and it shall be maintained as such at all times thereafter.

Condition : 26 - The development shall be built in two phases in line with submitted plans LP6080-20 and LP-6080-21. Phase 1 shall comprise demolition and piling, whilst Phase 2 will comprise above ground works.
description: Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to allow revised balustrading and feature corner glazed brick following planning permission 00676/33/S8 dated 30/01/2018 for the variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to allow various changes and the addition of a phasing condition following planning permission 00676/33/S6 dated 21/7/2017 for demolition of existing vacant / redundant single storey building and erection of a building up to eight storeys in height containing 74 flats and commercial / community space with uses A2 / D1 on ground floor
